description: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 16 to 28, with tick labels at integer values. There are four lines displayed: a purple line with circle markers representing “Consistency-CE”, which begins at approximately (0, 24.2) and increases to approximately (6, 26.5); a blue line with square markers representing “Inconsistency-CE”, which begins at approximately (0, 20.1) and increases to approximately (6, 25.2); a blue line with triangle markers representing “Inconsistency-CE-MP”, which begins at approximately (0, 19.8) and increases to approximately (6, 26.1); and a red line with star markers representing “Consistency-Bi”, which begins at approximately (0, 22.3) and increases to approximately (6, 27.3).
